How this pilot handles your photos
Batch collection briefly observes Lightroom’s normal rejected-photo response. It never replays requests or reads account tokens, cookies or hidden app stores. Google Photos search is approximate; the original filename in its Info panel must match exactly, and you approve identity visually. Photos with no readable filename cannot be approved. Adding to an album preserves the existing item; no image metadata is written. Browser-local state and exported manifests can contain private filenames and links.
The extension has access only to lightroom.adobe.com and photos.google.com. The two sites can change their interfaces; unsupported controls stop the operation. There are no delete or trash operations. A filename-only match is never sufficient for automatic approval.

  

  
Keep the originals. Carry only the decisions.
